## v2.7.0 — 2026-04-12

Version 2.7.0 introduces significant refactoring improvements including deprecated API cleanup, enhanced authentication utilities, and routing system improvements. This release also updates the legacy tier model throughout the system and addresses several security and configuration issues while maintaining backward compatibility in most areas.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Removed deprecated TEAM_* aliases and isTeamTier function as part of API cleanup

### 🔧 Improvements

- Replaced if/else router chain with declarative route table for better maintainability
- Added TTL to auth token cache and simplified billing webhook cache with extracted retry helper
- Added requireAuth and requireOrgAdmin helper functions to API utils for cleaner authentication handling
- Deduplicated site utilities into centralized site-common.js module
- Added comprehensive tests for YAML parser, environment resolution, and configuration edge cases

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Updated CI guard checks and E2E tests to support the new Free/Paid/Enterprise legacy tier model
- Added ignoreDeprecations configuration to handle TypeScript 6.0 baseUrl deprecation warning
- Updated vitest from 4.1.2 to 4.1.4 to resolve vite 8.0.2 security vulnerabilities
- Made release-notes workflow manual-only to prevent race conditions during releases

### 🧹 Chores

- Upgraded TypeScript from 5.9.3 to 6.0.2
- Updated minor and patch dependencies with 7 package updates

## v2.7.0 — 2026-04-12

This release, v2.7.0, delivers significant internal refactorings, critical fixes, and dependency updates. Key changes include the removal of deprecated team aliases, comprehensive testing for configuration, and various code quality improvements across the API and site. Several fixes address CI/CD processes, security vulnerabilities, and compatibility with the new legacy tier model and TypeScript 6.0, enhancing stability and maintainability.

### ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- Removed deprecated `TEAM_*` aliases and the `isTeamTier` utility, requiring updates for any code still relying on these.

### 🔧 Improvements

- Enhanced CI workflow by making the release notes generation manual-only to prevent race conditions.
- Added comprehensive tests for the configuration's YAML parser, environment variable resolution, and edge cases.
- Refactored routing logic from an `if/else` chain to a more maintainable declarative route table.
- Improved caching mechanisms by adding TTL to the auth token cache and simplifying the billing webhook cache, alongside extracting a common retry helper.
- Introduced `requireAuth` and `requireOrgAdmin` helper functions in `utils.ts` to streamline API authentication and authorization.
- Consolidated and deduplicated common site utilities into `site-common.js` for better code organization.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Addressed the TypeScript 6.0 `baseUrl` deprecation warning by adding `ignoreDeprecations`.
- Resolved security advisories by updating Vitest from 4.1.2 to 4.1.4.
- Updated CI guard checks, E2E tests, and `dashboard.js` to align with the new Free/Paid/Enterprise legacy tier model.

### 🧹 Chores

- Updated TypeScript to 6.0.2 and several other minor and patch dependencies.
- Updated documentation, including v2.6.0 release notes and a landing page hero badge.

v2.7.0 — 2026-04-12

This release introduces significant internal refactorings to enhance code quality, maintainability, and reliability, alongside critical bug fixes and security updates. Key changes include adapting to a new legacy tier model, improving testing infrastructure, and removing deprecated team-related aliases.

⚠️ Breaking Changes

  • Removed deprecated `TEAM_*` aliases and the `isTeamTier` utility, which may require updates to any custom integrations or configurations relying on these.

🔧 Improvements

  • Added comprehensive tests for the configuration's YAML parser, environment variable resolution, and edge cases, improving robustness.
  • Replaced the imperative `if/else` router chain with a declarative route table for improved maintainability and readability.
  • Improved cache management by adding a Time-To-Live (TTL) to the authentication token cache, simplifying the billing webhook cache, and extracting a common retry helper.
  • Introduced `requireAuth` and `requireOrgAdmin` helper functions in `utils.ts` for consistent and simplified API route protection.
  • Deduplicated common site utilities by consolidating them into `site-common.js` for better code organization.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Updated CI guard checks, E2E tests, and `dashboard.js` to fully align with the new Free, Paid, and Enterprise legacy tier model.
  • Fixed a race condition in the release-notes CI workflow by making it manual-only.
  • Addressed TypeScript 6.0 `baseUrl` deprecation warnings by adding `ignoreDeprecations` to the configuration.
  • Updated Vitest from 4.1.2 to 4.1.4 to resolve security advisories related to Vite 8.0.2.

🧹 Chores

  • Updated development dependency TypeScript to 6.0.2 and several other minor and patch dependencies.
